title: Calibration Protocol for Plate Reader Abs600 with Microsphere Particles
author: Jacob Beal
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bgy6jxze
materials: You have now completed this calibration protocol

steps.title: Prepare microsphere stock solution
steps.instruction: Obtain the tube labeled “Silica Beads” (≈300 µL) from the Measurement Kit, vortex it vigorously for 30 seconds, then pipet 100 µL of microspheres into a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube, add 900 µL ddH₂O, and vortex the tube for 10 seconds to create the microsphere stock solution.

substeps.instruction: Vortex Silica Beads tube for 30 seconds
Pipet 100 µL microspheres into 1.5 mL tube
Add 900 µL ddH₂O
Vortex stock tube for 10 seconds

steps.title: Add ddH₂O to plate
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL ddH₂O to every well in columns 2‑12 of rows A‑D (wells A2‑D12). Column 12 will contain only ddH₂O.

steps.title: Add stock to well A1
steps.instruction: Transfer 200 µL of the microsphere stock solution into well A1.

steps.title: Serial dilute row A
steps.instruction: Perform a 10‑fold serial dilution across row A by repeatedly transferring 100 µL from one well to the next, mixing each destination well by pipetting up/down three times, and discarding the final 100 µL into liquid waste. Do not continue into column 12.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 100 µL from A1 to A2
Mix A2 by pipetting up/down 3×
Transfer 100 µL from A2 to A3
Mix A3 by pipetting up/down 3×
Transfer 100 µL from A3 to A4
Mix A4 by pipetting up/down 3×
Transfer 100 µL from A4 to A5
Mix A5 by pipetting up/down 3×
Transfer 100 µL from A5 to A6
Mix A6 by pipetting up/down 3×
Transfer 100 µL from A6 to A7
Mix A7 by pipetting up/down 3×
Transfer 100 µL from A7 to A8
Mix A8 by pipetting up/down 3×
Transfer 100 µL from A8 to A9
Mix A9 by pipetting up/down 3×
Transfer 100 µL from A9 to A10
Mix A10 by pipetting up/down 3×
Transfer 100 µL from A10 to A11
Mix A11 by pipetting up/down 3×
Transfer 100 µL from A11 to liquid waste

steps.title: Serial dilute rows B‑D
steps.instruction: Repeat the same procedure for rows B, C, and D: add 200 µL of microsphere stock to B1, C1, and D1 respectively, then perform the 100 µL transfer‑mix sequence through column 11, discarding the final 100 µL into waste, while keeping column 12 filled only with ddH₂O.

steps.title: Re‑mix plate before reading
steps.instruction: Immediately before placing the plate in the reader, pipette each well up/down gently three times to resuspend beads, avoiding the creation of surface bubbles.

steps.title: Measure OD600
steps.instruction: Measure absorbance at 600 nm for all wells, ensuring any path‑length correction setting on the instrument is disabled. Use the same instrument settings as for any fluorescence standard‑curve measurements if the data will be combined.

steps.title: Record and import data
steps.instruction: Record the OD600 values in your notebook, then import the data into the Excel file “iGEM Data Analysis Template – Particle Standard Curve – v1.xlsx”.
